title: Blood Panel Recency and Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Delivery Spacing
content:
**Vet clinic coordination note — blood panels and prescription deliveries**

An aging recheck shortens the dosing days between shipments of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship. Blood panels are counted on any of the customer's Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans as panels redeemed less those voided on the plan in the same period.

| Blood panels in the last 12 months (redeemed less voided) | Blood panels in the last 6 months (redeemed less voided) | Days taken away |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 4 |
| 1 or more | 0 | 2 |
| 1 or more | 1 or more | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Cases (hypothetical, on one plan)

- One blood panel redeemed nine months ago, nothing since: 2 days taken away.
- One redeemed three months ago: no days taken away.
- One redeemed four months ago and voided on the plan since: the net count is 0 in both periods, 4 days taken away.
- Nothing redeemed in the last 12 months on any of the customer's plans: 4 days taken away.
